evidence: Touches fuzz harness utilities in `src/test/fuzz/util/reachability.*` and instruments 11 fuzz targets with corpus reachability assertions under the Fuzzing label.
rationale: Introduces a framework mechanism allowing corpus CI to detect when high-value execution paths are silently lost. As noted in commit bcf97a3cc4, this lets corpus replay CI detect lost path coverage without requiring a separate build configuration, directly protecting against fuzz coverage regressions across major targets.
